data.body: F12 passed its refreshed normal plan review after file impact expanded to 47 paths. The worktree is current with `origin/main`. Validation passes for both drift checks, 36 D3 tests, 221 D4 tests, nine held-out cases, lint, type checking across 639 files, whitespace, scope count, and the source-module line cap. The unrelated full suite was omitted by operator direction. F20 `alamode-greasy-jerboa` records inherited writing-guideline violations in generated CLI help without proposing mechanical enforcement. F12 is ready for commit and Gerrit.
